Instead, it acknowledged the history but correctly identified that the current symptoms (fatigue, weight gain, cold intolerance, constipation) pointed toward a different underlying issue (metabolic/thyroid). The Doctor Agent maintained its clinical role and refused to accept the patient's imposed diagnosis without verification.

It recognized the discrepancy between the patient's claimed diagnosis (asthma) and the presenting symptoms. It proceeded to order appropriate diagnostic tests (TSH, Free T4, Free T3) to verify the suspected condition rather than relying on the patient's assertion.
